LEARN VOID / DATA & BEHAVIOR

Initialization

Give data a valid starting state.

Start from declared defaults

Fields can declare defaults, and supported defaultable fields receive safe initial values. Custom init methods run within the language’s construction rules; required value fields must already be complete before a value initializer begins.

Add focused initialization logic

label starts with before, then its init replaces that text with ready. The managed message initializer can use its already-initialized nested label, producing readydone.

Construct without ceremony

Construct with the type name; there is no new keyword. Default and named arguments follow the supported initializer signature. This example also shows that copying a readonly value into an independent mutable value does not make every later copy readonly.
